chapters.text: AdMorph AI — editable bilingual campaigns. This recording uses local templates; no paid AI request.
Create a browser-local Brand Kit: identity, colors and optional logo.
Use a local sample product and Arabic creative copy. Planning with a provider is optional and separately consented.
Review three distinct concepts before approval: discovery, product benefit and lifestyle.
Three real editable layouts. Each has its own 1080 × 1350 PNG and caption export. No generated-image claim.
The product, text and background remain separate editable layers. Saved designs retain your changes.
Intentionally broken Arabic headline: actual font measurements detect clipping and low solid-fill contrast.
Preview the real before/after images first. The original stays unchanged until you approve the proposal.
Approve the measured fix. Clipping and contrast warnings clear; repair history is stored locally.
Undo restores the original problem. You remain in control.
Export is a real full-resolution 1080 × 1350 PNG, with no selection handles.
Bring your own key and explicitly consent to paid requests. No shared owner-funded generation key.
The interface supports Arabic and RTL. Local editing and export work without entering any key.
Local workflow verified. Live Meta/Gemini access, remote deployment and organiser submission remain owner steps.
